subject: maths
question: A class of 43 students took a Physics test. 10 students had an average score of 99. The other students had an average score of 55. What is the average score (rounded off to one decimal place) of the whole class?
solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 43

Students = 10, average = 99

Students = 33, average = 55

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total sum ÷ Total number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total marks of 10 students = 10 × 99 = 990

⇒ Total marks of 33 students = 33 × 55 = 1815

⇒ Total marks = 990 + 1815 = 2805

⇒ Average = 2805 ÷ 43 = 65.23

⇒ Rounded value = 65.2

**∴ The correct answer is 65.2.**
